node_relationship: Road endpoint FNODE/TNODE values reference the Roads_Intersection INTERID, not its OBJECTID.
levels: Endpoint codes express relative vertical separation: 0 below ground, 1 generally ground, 2 through 9 progressively above the base. A segment can transition levels; these are not measured elevations.

node_types.I: Normal intersection of at least three segments
node_types.X: Multiple use; requires review rather than an assumed physical intersection

current_domains: Live 2026 layer domains are archived separately and take precedence for current field types/codes; the older official documentation supplies semantics, not a current road survey.
precision: Candidate intersection estimates only, never verified historical accident positions.
